summary: Improve warehouse layout, inventory control, and dispatch performance with practical tools, KPI templates, and WMS-aligned exercises. Enrol now.
lede: Warehouse Optimization and Distribution Centre Management helps you improve layout flow, inventory accuracy, labour productivity, picking, packing, receiving, and dispatch reliability. You will use practical methods including ABC analysis, cycle counting, Warehouse Management Systems, Lean warehousing, KPI tracking, and safety risk assessment to identify where time, space, and stock are being lost. The course applies these methods through exercises that produce usable operational artefacts, including layout maps, control improvements, performance measures, and a 90-day improvement roadmap. It also introduces barcode, RFID, and dashboard-based visibility concepts, helping you make realistic improvements within existing budget, staffing, technology, safety, and fulfilment constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you work in warehouse, inventory, logistics, or distribution operations and need to improve control, flow, and reporting. Warehouse Supervisors managing daily receiving, picking, and dispatch flow. Distribution Centre Managers overseeing space, labour, and service targets. Inventory Controllers reconciling stock accuracy and cycle count results. Logistics Coordinators aligning warehouse schedules with transport departures. Supply Chain Analysts tracking warehouse KPIs and exception trends. Warehouse Operations Managers improving throughput and location control. Fulfilment Team Leads balancing picking productivity and order accuracy. Materials Managers controlling storage, replenishment, and stock movement. Warehouse Safety Officers reducing incident exposure in active storage areas. 3PL Operations Coordinators managing client stock and dispatch routines.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for exercises and a basic understanding of warehouse or logistics operations. If available, prepare a current warehouse layout, stock report, picking report, or KPI sheet for practical use during the course.
